description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for persistence ID streaming, including parameters such as batch size, timeouts, backoff durations, restart limits, and recovery period. It also includes an enumeration of known configuration keys with default values used throughout the system.

classes.name: PersistenceIdsConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods related to persistence ID streaming, including timeout and backoff durations, batch sizes, and restart limits.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of persistence IDs requested per batch from a remote service.

methods.name: getStreamRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for stream request replies.

methods.name: getStreamIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for keeping the persistence ID stream open without downstream activity.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration after a stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration after a stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream reconnection attempts before giving up.

methods.name: getRecovery
methods.description: Returns the duration after which the upstream is considered healthy if no errors occur.
